Game Overview

Alice and the Lost Candy is a skill title where join Alice on a whimsical journey through a candy-filled land. Navigate vibrant levels teeming with foes and puzzles as you dash, jump, and strategize to reclaim the lost sweets. Master timing and agility to overcome diverse obstacles while the ticking clock keeps you on your toes!
